'''Emerald's Sudowoodo''' (Japanese: '''エメラルドのウソッキー''' ''Emerald's Usokkie'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{adv|Emerald}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his second overall. She is at [[level]] 62 and her [[Characteristic]] is that she "hates to lose."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===
====As a wild Pokémon====
[[File:Emerald Sudowoodo enraged.png|thumb|150px|left|Sudowoodo enraged]]
{{p|Sudowoodo}} first appeared in ''[[PS303|Never Spritz a Knotty Sudowoodo]]'', when she went crazy due to being watered by [[Todd Snap]] while disguised as a tree and attacked him in a rage. {{adv|Emerald}} was able to use his E Shooter to calm her down and let her return to the wild. Sudowoodo reappeared in ''[[PS314|A Sketchy Smattering of Smeargle]]'' where it was revealed that she followed Emerald alongside a {{TP|Emerald|Dusclops}} to join Emerald's team. Both of them proceed to help fend off the {{p|Smeargle}} in [[Artisan Cave]] to help Emerald capture {{adv|Jirachi}}. They later defend Emerald from an attack from [[Guile Hideout]], which impressed Emerald enough to let them join him.

====With Emerald====
In ''[[PS317|Sneaky Like Shedinja]]'', Sudowoodo battled as Emerald's last Pokémon in his fight against [[Greta]]. Due to Dusclops having weakened {{p|Umbreon}}, she was able to finish it off with one {{m|Low Kick}}, giving him the win with a score of two to five. Greta sends out her final team member, a {{p|Shedinja}}. Greta points out that although Shedinja is weak, its {{a|Wonder Guard}} [[Ability]] makes it so that only a few moves can hurt it. Emerald counters with {{m|Rock Slide}}, a move that can defeat a Shedinja, but it uses {{m|Endure}} to survive the hit. Greta refuses to let the last round end with an assessment and has Shedinja fire off a {{m|Solar Beam}} at Sudowoodo. Emerald declares that he lost, but Todd points out that Sudowoodo is still able to battle. Todd edges Emerald to cheer for the Pokémon that have been fighting for him all this time. Although he struggles initially, Emerald manages to cheer Sudowoodo on and tells her to not give up. Sudowoodo smiles and manages to stand back up. The battle ends, and with an assessment, Emerald wins with a score of four to two, earning him the [[Symbol|Guts Symbol]].

[[File:Sudobo and Emerld Sudowoodo.png|thumb|150px|right|Sudowoodo and Sudobo]]
[[File:Emerald Sudowoodo Battle Dome.png|thumb|175px|left|Sudowoodo in the Battle Dome]]

During the [[Battle Dome]] challenge in ''[[PS320|Verily Vanquishing Vileplume II]]'', Sudowoodo advanced Emerald throughout the tournament, defeating an {{p|Ursaring}} with {{m|Counter}}. Sudowoodo was not used during his fight against [[Tucker]] due to Emerald believing he did not need his regular team to win. 

After losing to Tucker, Emerald challenged the [[Battle Palace]] in ''[[PS325|Standing in the Way with Starmie]]''. When Emerald learns that [[Guile Hideout]] had captured Jirachi, Emerald left {{TP|Emerald|Sceptile}}, Sudowoodo, and Dusclops to battle [[Spenser]] by themselves while he went to face Guile. [[PS327|Later]], {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios}} returns Emerald's Pokémon, along with the [[Symbol|Spirits Symbol]] they had won in the battle. 

In ''[[PS333|The Final Battle VI]]'', Sudowoodo joins the rest of Emerald's team in an attempt to attack Guile Hideout. Guile easily fights them off and begins attacking them, which forces Emerald to realize he truly cares about Pokémon. Seeing the change in his heart Jirachi grants his wish to free the [[Pokédex holder]]s from petrification. After the final battle with Guile Hideout, she became acquainted with {{adv|Gold}}'s Sudowoodo, [[Sudobo]].

==={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===
In ''[[PS604|Goodra Spits]]'', Sudowoodo battled alongside Dusclops to try and hold off [[Zinnia]] from stealing the dimensional shifter.

==Personality and characteristics==
[[File:Emerald and Sudowoodo.png|thumb|125px|Sudowoodo and Emerald]]
Sudowoodo was initially an angry and stubborn Pokémon, attacking {{Todd}} for accidentally pouring water on her. After {{adv|Emerald}} calmed her down, she became extremely loyal to him and sought him out to join him. She cares deeply for Emerald, once getting into a fight between his [[Emerald's Sceptile|other]] [[Emerald's Dusclops|Pokémon]] to see who would care for him.

Sudowoodo has shown considerable skill with creating drinks made out of {{Berries}}. By crushing up the Berries with her hands, she can make a variety of different beverages, such as a Berry juice, Berry float, or Berry parfait.
